items.source: Does not encode the URI template and instead applies strict encoding to URI variables via UriUtils.encodeUriVariables(Map) prior to expanding them into the template.
items.translation: 不编码 URI 模板，而是通过UriUtils.encodeUriVariables(Map)对 URI 变量进行严格编码，然后再将它们展开到模板中。

items.source: For most cases, this mode is most likely to give the expected result because in treats URI variables as opaque data to be fully encoded, while URI_COMPONENT by comparison is useful only if intentionally expanding URI variables with reserved characters.
items.translation: 对于大多数情况，此模式最有可能给出预期结果，因为它将 URI 变量视为需要完全编码的不透明数据，而相比之下，URI_COMPONENT 仅在有意使用保留字符展开 URI 变量时才有用。

items.source:
Enum to represent multiple URI encoding strategies. The following are available:
  • TEMPLATE_AND_VALUES
  • VALUES_ONLY
  • URI_COMPONENT
  • NONE
items.translation:
用于表示多种 URI 编码策略的枚举。可用的策略如下：
  • TEMPLATE_AND_VALUES
  • VALUES_ONLY
  • URI_COMPONENT
  • NONE

items.source: Expand URI variables first, and then encode the resulting URI component values, replacing only non-ASCII and illegal (within a given URI component type) characters, but not characters with reserved meaning.
items.translation: 首先扩展 URI 变量，然后对生成的 URI 组件值进行编码，仅替换非 ASCII 字符以及在给定 URI 组件类型中非法的字符，但不替换具有保留含义的字符。

items.source: No encoding should be applied.
items.translation: 无编码应被应用。

items.source: For the URI template replace only non-ASCII and illegal (within a given URI component type) characters with escaped octets.
items.translation: 对于 URI 模板，仅将非 ASCII 字符和（在给定 URI 组件类型内）非法字符替换为转义八位字节。

items.source:
For URI variables do the same and also replace characters with
reserved meaning.
items.translation: 对于 URI 变量也执行相同操作，并替换具有保留含义的字符。

items.source: Pre-encode the URI template first, then strictly encode URI variables when expanded, with the following rules: For the URI template replace only non-ASCII and illegal (within a given URI component type) characters with escaped octets.
items.translation: 首先对 URI 模板进行预编码，然后在展开时严格编码 URI 变量，遵循以下规则：对于 URI 模板，仅将非 ASCII 字符以及在给定 URI 组件类型中非法的字符替换为转义八位字节。
